arguments.summary: Investigated and addressed three prior issues related to ingress timeout, certificate expiration, and cron drift. The focus now is on the failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database, which has been growing all week. Pgbouncer connection pool refresh was also reviewed, but no immediate issues were found.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Proceed with the pg_dump export of the failed_jobs table and continue investigating the root cause of job failures to get the backlog moving again.
